description: Atomic per-agent integer counter (incr/decr/get/set/reset), scoped to the paying wallet. For tallies, quotas, sequence numbers. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional expiry in seconds (max 90 days; omit for none).

title: Agent Counter
